# Mixon

> Intelligent property, hospitality, retail POS, and event ticketing software for Africa, alongside custom web, mobile, USSD, M-Pesa, and AI engineering. Headquartered in Kilimani, Nairobi, Kenya, Mixon builds on the experience of Shiva Softwares Africa and integrates natively with Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja, card rails, and East African banking workflows.

- Canonical Site: https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/

## Flagship Software Platforms

- [miRentals — Property Management & Rent Reconciliation](https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/mirentals): Automates tenant ledgers, M-Pesa Daraja STK Push / Paybill matching in under 2 seconds, utility meter billing, and landlord reporting.
- [miReserve — Hospitality Channel Manager & Direct Booking](https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/mireserve): Syncs Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, and direct stays within 14ms to eliminate double bookings, plus self check-in smart locks and M-Pesa/card deposits.
- [Event Yetu — Event Ticketing & Offline Gate Access](https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/eventyetu): Sub-120ms anti-screenshot QR gate scanning (1,200+ scans/hr/attendant), offline-first venue sync, tiered tickets, and M-Pesa settlement.
- [miPOS — Offline-First Retail POS & Warehouse Stock](https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/mipos): Offline counter billing, ESC/POS thermal receipt & scanner support, split Cash/M-Pesa/card tenders, multi-branch stock transfers, and blind X/Z shift reports.

## Engineering & Growth Services

- [Services Directory](https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/services): Overview of bespoke engineering, telco USSD, payment integration, commerce, SEO/AEO/GEO, and AI automation.
- [Web Design & Development](https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/services/web): Sub-1.2s Core Web Vitals sites, headless CMS, and React/Next.js web applications.
- [Mobile App Development & USSD](https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/services/app): Offline-resilient iOS/Android apps and Safaricom/Airtel *384* telco USSD shortcodes requiring zero mobile data.
- [Search & Discovery (SEO, AEO & GEO)](https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/services/seo): Technical SEO, structured Schema.org graphs, and citation architecture for Google, Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
- [Payments & Integrations](https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/services/payments): Idempotent Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja STK Push, C2B/B2C, Stripe, Pesapal, DPO, and ERP middleware.
- [Modern E-Commerce](https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/services/ecommerce): Mobile-first checkouts synced in real time with physical store inventory via miPOS.
- [AI & Process Automation](https://mixonsoftwares.co.ke/services/ai): Zero-data-retention enterprise endpoints, approved-document retrieval, and human-in-the-loop workflow automation.
